Blink is an enterprise communication platform that supports employee experience and engagement for deskless frontline workers. Blink was founded in 2018 in London, United Kingdom, by Sean Nolan. The platform launched in January 2019 with bus transport company Stagecoach Group as its first customer.
The company raised seed funding of £8 million from Partech Partners and angel investors in 2020 and $20 million in its series A funding round, led by Next47 and with participation from Partech and Techstars, in 2021.
